output: I understand the concern: if clinic managers can't update their own staffing numbers, the work comes back to you. Model building does have a learning curve, and most non-finance users should start by entering and reviewing numbers rather than designing models. Role-based input views show each person only the numbers they own, and onboarding includes admin training so that a trained internal admin, not a consultant, handles routine model changes. For proof, [PLACEHOLDER] customer story: operations team updated its own headcount drivers after admin training. As a next step, I'd like to set up a hands-on session where two of your non-finance budget owners complete a real input task in a sandbox, so your clinic managers can see how it works before you decide.
